name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, northwestern Argentina. Diablillos is one of the world's largest undeveloped primary silver resources, with Measured & Indicated resources of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold across 232 million tonnes. The company completed a Preliminary Feasibility Study showing a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR, and is advancing the project toward a construction decision.
